title: Check 1 judges every artifact it is given, whether or not the tree holds a card

looked_in: contracts/validate.py check_01_schema at 6e74dbdc: 'if not cards: return ... N/A no cards found' comes before the artifact loop
a run over a scratch directory holding one harness_retro with four fields: check 1 N/A, 0 failed
the account of how HP-013's fixture was judged, from its builder

changes.change: check_01_schema returns N/A only when the tree holds neither a card nor an artifact. With artifacts and no cards it loads the registry and judges the artifacts, as it does now when cards exist. The missing-library PENDING path already covers artifacts.
A tree holding one malformed harness retro and no card, which must fail check 1. Watched accepted with the change absent, and rejected with it.

fixtures.path: contracts/history_fixtures.py, fixture_01_an_artifact_in_a_tree_without_cards_is_judged: a built repository with contracts/examples (every card) removed in a commit of its own, then a retro missing verdict; the row expects check 1 FAIL 'verdict' is a required property. A history row and not a rejected group, because --expect-fail judges every group in one bundle beside the other fixtures' cards, so a group cannot reach a tree without cards
fixtures.watched_failing_before: HEAD's validator at 351aecf9 on a copy of contracts/: the row BROKEN, check 1 N/A no cards found (builder's run)
fixtures.watched_passing_after: 7ca41a48: the row holds, the missing verdict the only check 1 line on the build (builder's run). Also read back by this seat: its scratch probe, a four-field retro and no card, gave check 1 N/A and 0 failed at 6e74dbdc and ten check 1 FAILs at 7ca41a48

replay.run_line: not a validator run: contracts/validate.py and the card contracts/examples/goal.json arrived together at 4734d8ae and goal.json was never deleted; of 3116 commits reachable, the 945 without goal.json carry no contracts/validate.py (dino-autofocus history from the subtree import, never gated here), so every tree this gate judged held a card (builder's count)

notes: A tightening: a tree that passed may now fail. The live repository always holds cards, so no commit's verdict should change; the replay is the builder's to show. Not proposed: validate.py's INCIDENT_ID regex is a fourth copy of the id shape, kept for its named groups and pointed at $defs/incident_id by a comment, with nothing comparing the two. Nothing has drifted, so no incident stands behind it; it is noted in the ledger, not proposed.
